title: Panshi world fact revision historical v1
description: One fact revision referenced by a WorldFactManifestHistoricalV1's interactionFactRevisionIds or outcomeEvidenceRevisionIds. Carries the same six world-time and rights fields as ../v1/fact-revision.schema.json (world_published_at, platform_received_at, observed_at, source_revision, supersedes_fact_id?, rights_scope), renamed to the camelCase style the manifest envelope and the public-v2 projections already use, plus the three fields historical mode adds: the owning manifestId, the truthClass/provenanceClass labels every synthetic claim must carry, and the sealed payload itself (a repo-owned synthetic fixture mirrors its own object, so the payload lives here rather than behind an upstream artifact fetch). This schema is never referenced by schema.json directly — the manifest only carries ID lists; fixtures load this schema separately to validate the accompanying fact revision records.

factRevisionId.description: Immutable identifier of this fact revision. Corrections append a new factRevisionId with supersedesFactRevisionId; they never overwrite. Historical-mode revisions live in this repository's own synthetic fact- namespace (the same namespace as the canonical event fixtures' fact-v5-golden-001), not the upstream sealed-facts sf_ namespace, because no upstream sealed fact is involved.

manifestId.description: The historical manifest that first sealed this revision, i.e. the session it originates in. Later sessions may reference the same revision id in their own allowlists; that does not change this field.

worldPublishedAt.description: When the fact was published into the world (e.g. exchange/company disclosure timestamp).

platformReceivedAt.description: When the platform received/ingested the fact. available_at = max(worldPublishedAt, platformReceivedAt).

observedAt.description: When the underlying source observation occurred, per the sealed-facts v1 provenance.observed_at convention.

sourceRevision.description: The source's own revision tag for this fact observation. Opaque to consumers.

supersedesFactRevisionId.description: Optional: the prior factRevisionId this revision corrects. The prior revision is never overwritten, matching the sealed-facts v1 supersedes rule.

rightsScope.description: Which allowlist(s) this revision is cleared for. "interaction" or "outcome" restrict the revision to one physically separate allowlist only; "interaction_and_outcome" means it is eligible for both, but each pipeline must still resolve it through its own list's explicit ref.

truthClass.description: docs/v5/product-constitution.md 「角色資料的五種身分」. A synthetic historical fixture is 虛構設定, never 真實資料; real_fact is unrepresentable here by construction, so no projection can ever quote one of these prices as a real market fact.

provenanceClass.description: This revision was generated inside this repository. It is not mirrored from, derived from, or licensed by any external market data source.

payload.description: The sealed content of this revision. Every numeric field is an integer in a declared fixed-point or basis-point scale; floating-point literals are not permitted anywhere in this contract.

instrumentLabel.description: Fictional instrument this revision is about. Never a real listed security.

summaryZhHant.description: Unquoted, structured Traditional Chinese statement of what the fact says. Never a character's words — character utterances are sealed separately as UtteranceArtifact.

minorUnitScale.description: Minor units per major unit for currency (TWD: 100). Required by kind sealed_close_price.

sealedClosePriceMinorUnitsFixed6.description: Sealed session close, in currency minor units further scaled by 1,000,000 — the same sealedPriceMinorUnitsFixed6 convention as contracts/openapi/public-v2.yaml. Required by kind sealed_close_price.

marketSessionFinalityState.description: Whether MarketSessionFinalityAccepted has been recorded for this revision's session. A revision that is not "accepted" may never appear in any manifest's outcomeEvidenceRevisionIds. Required by kind sealed_close_price.

carriedForwardFromFactRevisionId.description: Set when a pending session has no close of its own yet and the last accepted close is being carried forward as the as-of mark. Its presence is what makes the carried-forward number auditable instead of a silently reused price.

sessionMoveBasisPoints.description: Signed move in basis points. Required by kind market_momentum_signal.

peerGroupLabel.description: Fictional peer group this observation covers. Required by kind peer_group_inventory_days.

inventoryDaysFixed6.description: Days of inventory scaled by 1,000,000. Required by kind peer_group_inventory_days.

inventoryDaysChangeFixed6.description: Signed change in days of inventory versus the prior comparable period, scaled by 1,000,000. Required by kind peer_group_inventory_days.

correctsFactRevisionId.description: The revision this notice corrects. Required by kind issuer_correction_notice, and must equal supersedesFactRevisionId.
